description: DRAFT (scripts/block-face/draft-type.ts (src/canalRecall/blockFace/typeDraft.ts)) for the review turn. Dapperbuurt-Noord family 1880-1884, 5 storeys, 4.9-6.4 m wide: 28 pands on 5 block faces; median cornice 14.21 m, 3 window columns, wall #6f6058. Pane layout, head kind, cornice kind, crowns and ground variants are NOT measured: see draft.unmeasured.
